newsitem.title: JAPAN: Taito Corp to launch on-line karaoke system.
newsitem.headline: Taito Corp to launch on-line karaoke system.

text.p: Japanese game machine maker Taito Corp said on Thursday that it and Kyocera Multimedia Corp plan to introduce a new on-line karaoke system on October 16.
Taito said the system, called the Mediabox, will be priced at 39,800 yen, making it the cheapest system in the market. Taito's current system costs 64,800 yen.
The system's on-line services will also include games, on-line shopping and electronic mail. It can also be connected to the Internet, a Taito spokesman said.
The system can be used to view Internet home-pages beginning from December. On-line shopping and E-mail services will start next spring, Taito said.
Kyocera Multimedia will be the Internet provider.
The companies hope to sell at least 300,000 units of Mediabox in the first year, company officials said.
